$schema_note: Machine-readable index of this repo for coding agents. Fetch raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/houstongolden/bamfai-examples/main/examples.json

categories.examples: Small, single-purpose pieces (HTML pages, scripts) an agent can pull down and use directly in a session.
categories.starters: Full starter applications (Next.js, Vite, etc.) built on the BAMF API/MCP — scaffold a project from these.
categories.audiences: Every entry declares an 'audience': 'creator' (single-creator workflows — what's published here today) or 'agency' (multi-creator/agency workflows — planned in ROADMAP.md as coming soon, none published yet).

examples.title: creator.new Lovable Starter
examples.description: Remixable, open-source creator studio built natively on BAMF.ai for the creator.new Lovable app. Onboarding picks platforms and formats, then drafts in the creator's voice through the BAMF API/MCP. Accounts connect through BAMF; no social OAuth in the app.
examples.when_to_use: When you want a remixable Lovable creator studio (private by default) that drafts per platform and format through a creator-scoped BAMF key held in an edge function.
requires: Lovable Cloud or Supabase with Edge Functions

examples.title: Post Review HTML
examples.description: BAMF-branded local HTML page for reviewing generated post drafts with exact LinkedIn line-break rendering. Agents: generate drafts, render this, open it, keep editing in chat.
examples.when_to_use: Any time you create or edit BAMF post drafts in a terminal agent session and the user needs to review copy.

examples.title: Lovable Creator App Prompts
examples.description: Staged prompts for scaffolding a secure Vite, React, and Supabase creator app in Lovable with BAMF capability discovery, generation, exact approval gates, optional scheduling, and LinkedIn connector diagnostics.
examples.when_to_use: When building a custom single-creator Lovable app against the public BAMF API without exposing a BAMF key or private BAMF implementation details.
requires: Supabase or Lovable Cloud with Edge Functions

examples.title: Creator-Led Resource Video Skill
examples.description: Reusable skill for original creator-led tutorial, free-resource promotion, and legitimate giveaway scripts and video shot plans.
examples.when_to_use: When planning a short creator-led video with a real offer, approved likeness/voice assets, and a truthful CTA.
